scope: Geometry and animation logic; no WebGL, canvas pixels or live browser validation

checks.name: skater geometry stays within the existing camera height and draw budget
skater blade stays in the accepted collision footprint instead of lengthening reach
goalie geometry stays within the existing camera height and draw budget
goalie stick remains a separately movable mesh inside its original blade footprint
woven goal geometry is finite and batched within a small draw budget
net covers only the roof, rear and sides, leaving the goal mouth open
ice scuff and roughness maps use linear data and align with the color texture
crowd density and geometry are bounded without one draw per person
more distant tiers have less contrast
idle crowd motion moves shared instance poses
pause, reduced motion or a hidden crowd suppress all animation writes
goal reaction changes the pose without waiting for another idle frame
decorative updates are throttled below the game physics rate
reduced-motion reset returns to the initial crowd pose
sustained idle/goal animation stays finite and off the ice

observations.caveat: Node CPU only; does not measure browser GPU rendering or FPS
